title: Green Rate by Weekday
summary: The share of sessions closing above their open, split by weekday. Each row's denominator is every complete session on that weekday in your data; the numerator is the green ones. Weekday folklore is abundant and mostly noise: the per-row intervals and the stability split are the test, and the attached open-to-close return distribution shows whether a 'strong day' is a rate effect or a size effect.
deltas: per-weekday N and 95% CI instead of five bare percentages
return distribution alongside the rate separates frequency from magnitude
condition the whole split on anything: gaps, events, volatility regime
